scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=app/shared && npm run build --workspace=app/api && npm run build --workspace=app/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=app/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=app/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=app/shared && npm run test --workspace=app/api && npm run test --workspace=app/frontend && npm run test:scripts

scripts.dev:demo: npm run build --workspace=app/shared && npm run dev:demo --workspace=app/frontend
